problem.title: Remove Duplicates From Sorted Array Ii

approaches.title: In-place two-pointer filtering
approaches.summary: Scans the sorted array while writing accepted values in place, allowing each value to appear at most twice. Revision 2 simplifies the state tracking by comparing each candidate with the value two positions behind the write pointer.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Tracks the previous value and its occurrence count while compacting allowed elements in place. Handles duplicate runs by retaining at most two copies.

Refactors the same in-place strategy to compare each candidate with the element two output positions earlier, eliminating explicit count and previous-value state. Adds an early return for arrays shorter than three elements.
